dict.string: DropNotch shows the current track, its artwork and progress from Music and Spotify, and sends play, pause, skip and seek commands when you use the controls in the notch.
DropNotch shows your upcoming events in the notch. It only reads your calendars: it never adds, changes or deletes events, and nothing leaves your Mac.
DropNotch keeps a link to files you drop on the notch, so they stay in the tray.
